evals.prompt: We are starting a new research inquiry on 'distributed-consensus-raft' in software engineering. Set up the research journal entry, initialize the log, and record the initial research prompt.
evals.expected_output: Creates the chronological entry under entries/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD_distributed-consensus-raft/ with logs.md, prompts.json, outputs/, and sources/, and appends the initial prompt.
assertions: Invokes log_research.py new-entry with topic distributed-consensus-raft
Directory structure contains logs.md and prompts.json
Prompts file records the initial iteration without errors

evals.prompt: Initialize a research journal repository from scratch, ensuring templates and gitignore are placed correctly.
evals.expected_output: Executes log_research.py init-repo to scaffold docs/templates/, entries/archives/, and .gitignore.
assertions: .gitignore excludes heavy outputs and secret files
